WELCOME TO MINI.

AN ICON SINCE 1959 —
AND WE’RE JUST
GETTING STARTED.
The dilemma: A fuel crisis in post-World War II England. The solution? The Mini, crafted by top
engineers to comfortably seat four, despite being a mere 10 feet long. And that meant reinventing
the wheel (so to speak) with the groundbreaking transverse engine, which provided stability during
tight turns and maximized interior passenger space.
When the first Mini began to motor in 1959, the world had never seen a car quite like it. Its unique
combination of classic British style in a nimble package came to symbolize independence and
spontaneity — characteristics MINI embodies to this day.
Nearly six decades later, MINI is as innovative as ever. Proving that amazing efficiency, superior
handling and an almost limitless range of customization opportunities are truly timeless qualities.
And there’s more to come around the bend.
DESIGN MATTERS.

Design is an integral part of the MINI experience, and today’s MINI is iconic as ever. The design of the original echoes through
its exquisite bodywork, while modern craftsmanship is on display. Each curve is purposeful, every detail refined to pack more
power and punch into a compact package.
Art and machine work together in tandem, a seamless blend of style and engineering. It’s a level of sophistication that is simply
unrivaled in its class. MINI has designed a sleek and savvy motoring experience — and you’re invited along for the ride.

PUNCHING ABOVE
OUR WEIGHT.
In 1961, the ground-breaking Mini caught the attention of British racing legend
John Cooper. Thanks to its superior design and engineering, this underdog blew
away the competition with its ability to outrace and outlast the bigger sedans of
the day.
A scrappy fighter, MINI has made regular visits to the winner’s circle and
chalked up numerous international race wins — including three at the
prestigious Monte Carlo Rally and, more recently, four Dakar rallies in a row.
On the road or at the track, today’s MINI continues to cater to discerning
motorers who seek skill, smarts and grit in a superior machine.

THE MINI HARDTOP 2 DOOR.
The true original and the one that started it all. The MINI Hardtop is feistier and more fun than ever, thanks to the
MINI TwinPower Turbo engines developed with the BMW Group. Exhilarating features such as LED headlights (optional) and
MINI Connected mobile command center add to the thrill. But despite all the premium enhancements, this sleek 2-door still has
the same heart and soul as the original MINI.

THE NEW MINI COUNTRYMAN.
MINI has crafted an entirely new vehicle from the ground up. The bigger, sportier MINI Countryman comes
equipped with standard features you might expect to be optional. Added cabin space to make room for fresh
thinking, a panorama sunroof to give you more perspective and rain-sensing wipers to keep your story going
through unexpected elements. Let the New MINI Countryman lead the way to adventure.

RACING IS IN OUR BLOOD.
MINI JOHN COOPER WORKS. In the course of a career that revolutionized racing, John Cooper,
the British racing legend, collected three Monte Carlo Rally titles and 16 Grand Prix wins. A
fitting tribute to a racing icon, MINI John Cooper Works vehicles offer a potent combination of
balanced handling and ballistic acceleration. They are tuned to achieve performance normally
reserved for race cars. That may be the reason that a MINI has won the famed Dakar rally four
times in a row.
Above: MINI John Cooper Works Convertible, MINI John Cooper Works Hardtop. Opposite page: MINI John Cooper Works Clubman.
HIGHLIGHTS FOR JOHN COOPER WORKS MODELS
228 hp 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with TwinPower Turbo technology
6-speed manual transmission (6- or 8-speed Sport Automatic transmission optional)
Powerful John Cooper Works brakes with red 12.4” Brembo calipers
John Cooper Works Sport suspension
John Cooper Works performance seats
Specially-tuned sport exhaust systems
Unique motorsport-derived aerodynamic modifications

ONCE AGAIN, THE WHEEL
CHANGES EVERYTHING.
MINI Connected is the intuitive command center for your MINI. It puts a wide range of tools,
services and apps at your fingertips that give you directions, keep you in touch with your friends,
and help you find parking — and the perfect playlist. It’s innovation, front and center.
These are a few of the standard and optional features that turn any trip into a high-tech adventure:
NAVIGATION. Travel to your destination with confidence. Our Navigation System will tell you where
you are and get you where you want to go, with turn-by-turn directions so you can keep your eyes on
the road.
SPOTIFY. MINI Connected lets you connect to services and apps like Spotify®, so you can rock out as
you roll out. Get access to all the music you’ll ever need, right through your MINI sound system.*
HEAD-UP DISPLAY. Maybe the only premium feature that won’t turn heads. Head-Up Display rises
from the driver’s side dash and keeps your eyes pointed straight ahead by showing speed, apps and
notifications.
RESPONSIVE TOUCHSCREEN DISPLAY. The optional 8.8" touchscreen display puts navigation and
media controls at your fingertips. Available on select MINI Clubman and Countryman models.
*Data and subscription charges apply.

UNIQUELY
YOURS.
One of the best things about a
MINI is making it uniquely your
own. With a huge selection of
customizable options — including
roof graphics, bonnet or sport
stripes, mirror caps, racing lamps,
alloy wheels and a variety of
exterior colors — your MINI will
be a perfect reflection of you.
shopminiusa.com

DETAIL DRIVEN.
Attention to detail is part of what makes driving a MINI a premium experience. You can expect perfection
is every seam, edge, curve and stitch. From its precise engineering to its lush interior cabin, MINI sets
the standard for sophistication and style.

MINI ALL4.
We’ve taken the MINI ALL4 all-wheel drive system and made it even smarter for better performance in virtually all
conditions. When the system detects the need for four-wheel drive, ALL4 intelligently routes power to the wheels with
better traction in as little as ¼ of a second.

SAFETY RUNS IN THE FAMILY.
YOU CAN NEVER BE TOO SECURE. That’s why every MINI is packed with safety features in a compact, efficient package.
However, avoiding an accident in the first place is a much better outcome, which is why every MINI includes a host of active
safety features including Dynamic Stability Control and the latest-generation four-channel Anti-lock Brake System.
CRASH-TEST GENIUS.
In the event of an impact accident,
doors unlock, interior and hazard lights
turn on and the fuel pump shuts down.
When a car can think for itself in the
event of an accident, you know it’s
pretty brilliant.
ADDITIONAL SAFETY FEATURES
Eight airbags standard on MINI Hardtop 2 Door and 4 Door, Clubman and
Countryman models. Six airbags on the MINI Convertible.*
Rigid body structure and advanced crumple zones channel collision forces
away from the passenger compartment.
Standard Anti-lock Brake System with Corner Brake Control helps to ensure
optimum braking performance in any situation.
Available Dynamic Traction Control with Electronic Differential Lock Control
for enhanced cornering, standard on John Cooper Works.
*Airbags on all models may not deploy simultaneously.

LEAVE THE SURPRISES
FOR THE ROAD.
You know where your Certified Pre-Owned MINI is going. We know where it’s been. Every model is
thoroughly tested and approved, with 100% MINI parts and a premium protection plan. Everything you
need to make MINI, and the road, yours.
PROGRAM DETAILS
Less than 5 years old. Although every MINI is young at heart, a Certified Pre-Owned MINI is
actually still young.
Less than 60,000 miles. Low mileage means plenty of serious motoring still to come.
Genuine MINI parts. Any parts used to repair or service MINI CPO vehicles are the real deal —
100% MINI.
MINI Certified Pre-Owned Protection Plan.* MINI Certified Pre-Owned Protection Plan is up to
6-year/100,000-mile warranty* from original in-service date.
MINI Certified Pre-Owned 575 Protection Plan.** For the younger cars (less than 36,001 miles),
the MINI Certified Pre-Owned 575 Protection Plan is up to 5-year/75,000-mile warranty** from
original in-service date.
Roadside Assistance plan. On the off chance of a breakdown, Roadside Assistance will come to
you and help get you back on your way ASAP. Roadside Assistance is good for the length of your
protection plan.
Rigorously inspected. MINI trained technicians inspect and certify every MINI CPO candidate.
* E very MINI Certified Pre-Owned vehicle is covered for up to 6 years or 100,000 miles (whichever comes first). MINI Certified Pre-Owned Protection Plan
provides coverage for 2 years or 50,000 miles (whichever comes first) from the date of the expiration of the 4-year/50,000-mile MINI New Passenger Car
Limited Warranty, which starts from the in-service date. MINI CPO cars are only available at authorized MINI Dealers. Please see your MINI Dealer for complete
details.
** E very MINI Certified Pre-Owned 575 vehicle is covered for up to 5 years or 75,000 miles (whichever comes first). MINI Certified Pre_Owned 575 Warranty
Program provides coverage for 1 year or 25,000 miles (whichever comes first) from the date of the expiration of the 4-year/50,000-mile MINI New Passenger
Car Limited Warranty, which starts from the in-service date. MINI 575 cars are only available at authorized MINI Dealers. Please see your MINI Dealer for
complete details.

you are and get you where you want to go, with turn-by-turn directions so you can keep your eyes on
the road.

you roll out. Get access to all the music you’ll ever need, right through your MINI sound system.*

from the driver’s side dash and keeps your eyes pointed straight ahead by showing speed, apps and
notifications.

media controls at your fingertips. Available on select MINI Clubman and Countryman models.
